description: Fork of exp732 (val=1.3912 @ 276.8M, fp32 LUT storage + bf16 LUT compute, fp32 head, standard Lion, no grad clip). Single change: wrap self.unembedder(x_resid) + F.cross_entropy in torch.amp.autocast(bf16) so the head matmul runs bf16 too. Tests bf16 head on the 'all weights stored fp32, bf16 only for compute' policy baseline (exp737 v2 was off-policy with bf16 LUT storage + Lion master). Compare to exp732 = 1.3912.
